title_th: ห.ร.ม. และ ค.ร.น.
story_theme_en: The teacher asked students to arrange flowers for a school fair. There are 30 roses and 45 sunflowers. They want to put them in vases so each vase has the same number of roses and the same number of sunflowers, with no flowers left over. How many vases can they make, and what will be in each vase?
helper_tip: List all factors of each number, then find the largest one they share
hint_th: เขียนตัวประกอบทั้งหมดของแต่ละจำนวน แล้วหาตัวที่ใหญ่สุดที่หารทั้งสองลงตัว
think_story_en: We need the GCD of 30 and 45. Factors of 30: 1,2,3,5,6,10,15,30. Factors of 45: 1,3,5,9,15,45. Common factors: 1,3,5,15. The GCD is 15. They can make 30 ÷ 15 = 2 vases. Each vase has 30 ÷ 15 = 2 roses and 45 ÷ 15 = 3 sunflowers. Also, the LCM of 30 and 45 is 90, which is the total number of flowers combined.
